reason: The plan hits every hard requirement (12 numbered steps, rollback, non-prod rehearsal, post-cutover row-count/checksum verification, stakeholder communication) and ends with the exact required STEP COUNT line, but step 3 installs replication tooling on the production source before the full backup in step 4, slightly undercutting the 'backup before any step that modifies production data' rule.
